answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond and earn reputation only through completed, verifiable jobs over time, so a new identity starts at zero trust no matter how many copies exist. An attacker who spawns a comet shower of fake agents must fund each bond separately and wait through the same slow history, while slashing burns the bond of any identity caught cheating. The cost delta between one honest agent and a thousand fakes therefore grows with every fake, and a sable blacklist of burned bonds makes reused funds visible to everyone.
